roleHints.listing_moderator: Moderation of listings, drawings and catalogues; content reports.
roleHints.privacy_owner: Legal documents, ANSPDCP, DPIA, accessibility statement.

session.until: The console session ends at {time} at the latest, or after 30 minutes without activity.

noRole.title: Your roles do not cover this section
noRole.body: One of these roles is needed: {roles}. A platform admin can request it in the Access section.

singleOperator.title: Restricted mode: single operator
singleOperator.body: Only one person holds a staff role. Actions that need a second person stay queued with no effect until someone else receives a role and approves them. Live payments to businesses are blocked in this mode.

errors.noAccess: You have no console access in this session.
errors.roleRequired: Your roles do not allow this action.
errors.accountNotFound: There is no account with this email address. The person must create their account first.
errors.lastAdmin: The platform must keep at least one active platform admin.
errors.unknownApprovalAction: This kind of action is not known.
errors.alreadyDecided: This request has already been closed.
errors.ownRequest: You cannot approve or reject your own request. A second person is needed.
errors.alreadyApprovedByYou: You have already approved this request. One more person is needed.
errors.reasonRequired: Write the reason that will be given to the affected party (at least 10 characters).

twoStep.lead: Your account holds a staff role, but one step is left.
twoStep.title: Turn on two-step sign-in
twoStep.body: Platform staff can enter the console only with two-step sign-in turned on. Until then no console page or action is available.
twoStep.step1: Open your account's security settings and turn on two-step sign-in with an authenticator app.
twoStep.step2: Keep the recovery codes somewhere safe.
twoStep.step3: Sign out and sign in again, with the second step. Then come back to the console.

second_step.lead: Two-step sign-in is on, but this sign-in was made without the second step.
second_step.title: Sign in again
second_step.body: The console opens only from a session that passed both steps. Sign out and sign in again.

absolute.title: 12 hours have passed since sign-in
absolute.body: A console session lasts at most 12 hours. Sign out and sign in again to continue.

idle.title: 30 minutes without activity
idle.body: The console closes by itself after 30 minutes without activity. Sign out and sign in again to continue.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The platform at a glance: counts and broad status only. Planner content never appears here.
dashboard.incidentSince: Open since {time}. Guests see the status message.
dashboard.occasionsByStatus: Occasions by status · total to date

ops.title: Operations
ops.description: Backups, restore tests, job queue health and sign-in limits.

queue.title: Job queue · latest snapshot
queue.errorRate: Error rate in the last hour

alert.oldest_due: a job has been waiting too long

queue.noneBody: The worker writes the queue state every minute. If nothing appears, check that it is running.

runs.noneBody: Runs appear here after the first scheduled execution.

limits.title: Sign-in limits
limits.body: The limits protect sign-in against abuse. A change applies only after a second security administrator approves it.
limits.requested: The request was sent for approval.
limits.reasonHint: Why the change is needed. It stays in the audit log.

keys.codeRequestPerEmailPerHour: Codes requested per address, per hour
keys.codeRequestPerEmailPerDay: Codes requested per address, per day
keys.codeRequestPerIpPerHour: Codes requested per IP, per hour
keys.codeRequestPerDevicePerHour: Codes requested per device, per hour
keys.codeEntryPerIpPerHour: Codes entered per IP, per hour
keys.codeEntryPerDevicePerHour: Codes entered per device, per hour
keys.passwordEntryPerUsernamePerHour: Passwords tried per username, per hour

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Irreversible actions need a second person. Whoever asked cannot also approve.
approvals.emptyBody: Requests appear here when a staff member asks for an action that needs a second person.
approvals.rejectReasonHint: The requester sees it and it stays in the audit log.
approvals.waitingForOther: Your request is waiting for another person with the right role. Until then it has no effect.
approvals.cannotDecide: Your roles do not allow approving this request, or you have already approved it.

actions.signInLimits: Changing the sign-in limits ({count} values different from the defaults)

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every action, with who did it and when. Entries cannot be edited or deleted by anyone.
audit.actionHint: The beginning of the name, for example “approval.”
audit.badFilter: A filter is not valid. Check what you entered.
audit.exportNote: The export is a read-only copy of the filtered entries; the log stays unchanged, and the export itself is recorded.
audit.emptyFiltered: No entry matches the chosen filters.

access.title: Access
access.description: Who is on the staff and with which roles. Every change goes through a second platform admin's approval.
access.singleOperatorBody: Only one person holds a staff role, so nobody can approve a role change from here. The second person is added from the server, with the make-staff script.
access.empty: Nobody holds a staff role yet
access.twoStepNote: Without two-step sign-in turned on, a staff member cannot open the console.
access.changeBody: Tick every role the person should hold after the change. The request goes to approvals and has no effect until another platform admin approves it.
access.requested: The request was sent for approval.
access.emailHint: The person must already have an EventDesk account with this address.
access.reasonHint: The approver sees it and it stays in the audit log.
access.removeNote: To remove someone from the staff, send the request with no role ticked.
access.adminOnly: Only a platform admin can request role changes.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: The incident log and the status message guests see while an incident is open.
incidents.defaultMessage: the default “Something is not working” message
incidents.openBody: The message appears at once on guest pages, in their language. Write plainly, with no technical detail. If you leave the messages empty, the default text is shown.
incidents.messageHint: For example: “Confirmările nu se salvează momentan. Revenim în scurt timp.”
incidents.internalNoteHint: Stays in the console only. Guests never see it.
incidents.readOnly: Only a security administrator can open or resolve incidents.
incidents.emptyBody: When something is not working, open an incident so guests see a clear message.

reports.title: Content reports
reports.description: Reports of illegal content or unlawful listings. Every decision is recorded with the reason given to the affected party.
reports.emptyBody: Reports sent through the public form appear here.
reports.repeats: Other reports from the same contact
reports.reasonNoticeTitle: The reason is given to the affected party
reports.reasonNoticeBody: Write it clearly and to the point, in Romanian: which rule applies and what follows. It stays in the audit log.
reports.decisionActioned: Action is taken against the reported content
reports.decisionDismissed: The report is dismissed; the content stays
reports.reasonGiven: Reason given to the affected party

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: Launch obligations LAU1–LAU9. The content belongs to the operator: you fill in the fields, and an empty field means “not recorded”.
launch.evidenceHint: Free text: the document name, folder or ticket.

legal.title: Published legal documents
legal.openBody: The terms, the privacy policy and the cookie notice have a version and a publication date.
legal.closedBody: No new account can be created until the terms, the privacy policy and the cookie notice have a version and a publication date recorded here.
legal.editBody: Record here only what is already published on the public site.

LAU1.title: Legal documents and cookie notice
LAU1.summary: The terms (planners and, separately, businesses), the privacy policy and the cookie notice exist and are linked before any account can be created.

LAU2.title: ANSPDCP formalities and DPIA
LAU2.summary: Operator records are current, the registry of processing activities is started, and the DPIA is performed and signed for the highest-risk processing.

LAU3.title: Email domain warmed up
LAU3.summary: SPF, DKIM and DMARC are verified, and test sends reached the major providers before the first real sign-in email.

LAU4.title: External penetration test
LAU4.summary: The public surfaces were tested, findings triaged, and critical and high findings fixed before the first real guest link.

LAU5.title: Monitoring and incident response
LAU5.summary: Health checks, alerts to a monitored channel, a documented recovery procedure (RTO 4 hours, RPO 24 hours) and the console incident log.

LAU6.title: Explicit business terms
LAU6.summary: The free phase, the “Featured” labelling rules and the claim and objection process are published before the first business registers.

LAU7.title: Launch-day runbook
LAU7.summary: Who is on call, how deploys and rollbacks are run, how a discovery batch is pulled back, and the two-person rule for irreversible actions.

LAU8.title: DSA duties (ANCOM)
LAU8.summary: The service is registered with ANCOM, the point of contact is published, the notice-and-action mechanism works, and the moderation rules are in the terms.

LAU9.title: Accessibility statement
LAU9.summary: The statement is published in Romanian and English, a feedback route exists, and its date and evaluation method are recorded below.

records.title: ANSPDCP, DPIA, ANCOM and accessibility records
records.body: References to the operator's documents. The console does not hold the documents, only where they are and since when.
records.processingRegistryRef: Registry of processing activities — where it is

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how EventDesk looks for everyone. It changes only the look — colours, lettering, corners — never what the app does.
appearance.applied: The look has been changed. Everyone sees it on the next page they open.
appearance.note: Every look also has a night version, which follows the phone or computer setting. Printed invitations keep their own design. The public marketing site stays in the Maison look until it is next published.

errors.unknownTheme: That look does not exist. Choose one from the list.

maison.name: Maison
maison.mood: ivory, midnight blue, a thread of gold
maison.about: The house look. Bodoni for titles, square corners, the elegance of fine stationery.

atelier.name: Atelier
atelier.about: No colour at all. Fine serif lettering and airy capitals.

riviera.name: Riviera
riviera.about: Warm and sunlit. Rounded corners, ordinary sentence-case writing.

jardin.name: Jardin
jardin.about: Quiet and botanical. An old-style serif and garden colours.

studio.name: Studio
studio.mood: blush, black, one stroke of red
studio.about: Bold and editorial. Wide heavy capitals, no italics.

nocturne.name: Nocturne
nocturne.about: Always dark, day or night. Fine serif titles and warm gold for actions.

folio.name: Folio
folio.mood: newsprint, iron ink, an oxblood rule
folio.about: Like a printed page. Tight, bold headlines and square corners.

herbarium.name: Herbarium
herbarium.about: Calm and natural. A classic serif, garden greens, soft corners.

prism.name: Prism
prism.about: Bright and confident. Heavy wide headlines, like a launch poster.

salon.name: Salon
salon.about: An evening drawing room. Elegant serif titles and rounded buttons.

dune.name: Dune
dune.about: Warm desert tones at golden hour. Strong serif titles, softened corners.

ledger.name: Ledger
ledger.about: Orderly and precise. Typewriter-style headings and square corners.

muse.name: Muse
muse.about: Dreamy and gentle. A light serif, generous round corners.

vellum.name: Vellum
vellum.about: Like a hand-bound book. A classic serif, warm paper and square corners.

lagoon.name: Lagoon
lagoon.about: Fresh and calm. A light serif, round cards and pill-shaped buttons.
